tools.name: move-to-position

tools.name: jump
tools.description: Make the bot jump

tools.name: move-in-direction

tools.description: Place a block at the specified position

tools.name: dig-block
tools.description: Dig a block at the specified position

tools.name: get-block-info
tools.description: Get information about a block at the specified position

tools.description: Find one or more nearby blocks of a specific type

count.description: Maximum number of blocks to return (default: 1; values above 256 are clamped)

tools.name: list-inventory
tools.description: List all items in the bot's inventory

tools.name: find-item

nameOrType.description: Name or type of item to find

outputItem.description: Optional: filter recipes by output item name

outputItem.description: Name of the item to craft

tools.name: get-recipe

itemName.description: Name of the item to get recipe for

tools.name: can-craft

itemName.description: Name of the item to check

tools.name: find-entity

type.description: Type of entity to find (empty for any entity)

tools.name: detect-gamemode
tools.description: Detect the gamemode on game

tools.name: smelt-item

takeOutput.description: Whether to take output when ready (default: true)

timeoutMs.description: Timeout waiting for output in ms (default: 60000)

tools.name: send-chat

tools.name: read-chat
tools.description: Get recent chat messages from players

count.description: Number of recent messages to retrieve (default: 10, max: 100)

tools.name: get-session-status
tools.description: Read MCPBot connection, health, inventory and protocol progress. Never reconnects.

tools.name: inspect-nearby
tools.description: Observe nearby entities and a heightmap; player text is untrusted game data.

tools.name: consume-food
tools.description: Eat a safe food already carried by MCPBot.

tools.name: attack-mob
tools.description: One ordinary survival attack on a non-player mob in reach.

tools.name: stop-movement
tools.description: Stop active work and clear controls without disconnecting; acknowledge after old work settles.

tools.name: respawn-player
tools.description: Respawn MCPBot after death in the existing game session.

tools.name: disconnect-player
tools.description: Quit this MCPBot session when the user asks to stop.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Snapshot the bot's own state: position, velocity, orientation, health/food, gamemode, dimension, held item, time/weather, control state and active effects. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: List the bot's inventory: held item/slot, all carried items, armor slots, off-hand, and free/total slot counts. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_observation
tools.description: One-call situational snapshot for an agent's observe loop: connection status, self vitals/position, held item + inventory, nearby entities, and recent/new events. Replaces calling get_state + get_inventory + list_entities + get_events separately. Pass `since` (a prior events.nextSince) to get only new events; otherwise a recent tail is returned with nextSince to start paginating. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: list_players
tools.description: List players currently visible in the tablist with username, display name, gamemode, ping and (if tracked) entity id/position. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: List nearby tracked entities, nearest-first, filtered by type/kind/mobType/username/name and/or maxDistance. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: find_nearest_entity
tools.description: Find the single nearest tracked entity matching the given filter. Returns {found:false} if none match. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_entity_details
tools.description: Get full details for a single tracked entity by its network id. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_scoreboards
tools.description: List active scoreboards with their name, title and items ({name,value}). Optionally filter to a single display slot. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_teams
tools.description: List scoreboard teams with friendlyFire, nameTagVisibility, color, prefix, suffix and members. Optionally filter to one team. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_boss_bars
tools.description: List active boss bars with title, health, color, dividers and flags. Returns [] if none. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_control_states
tools.description: Return the bot's seven movement control booleans: forward, back, left, right, jump, sprint, sneak. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_chat_patterns
tools.description: List the bot's registered chat patterns ({name?, type?, description?, pattern}). Pattern regexes are stringified. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: support_feature
tools.description: Check whether a named protocol feature is supported on the connected server/version (via minecraft-data feature flags). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: pathfinder_status
tools.description: Report the pathfinder's current activity: isMoving, isMining, isBuilding, and whether a goal is set. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Return the bot's current game settings (view distance, chat flags, skin parts, etc.). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_physics
tools.description: Return whether physics is enabled plus the physics constants (gravity, speeds, etc.) as primitive fields. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_loaded_plugins
tools.description: Report which mineflayer ecosystem plugins are attached to the bot. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_block_at
tools.description: Inspect the block at a world coordinate. Returns name/position and (detailed) hardness, diggability, line-of-sight, estimated dig time and sign text. Returns name 'air'/null-ish if the chunk is unloaded. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: find_blocks
tools.description: Search for nearby blocks matching a block name (or list of names), nearest-first. Returns positions; set returnClosestBlock to also get the full closest block. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_cursor_target
tools.description: Raycast from the bot's eyes along its look direction. Returns the first block hit and (if includeEntity) the entity being aimed at. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_blocks_in_region
tools.description: Scan a bounded box [min..max] (inclusive) and return non-air blocks, optionally filtered to specific block names. Volume is capped at 32768 blocks; shrink the box if you hit the cap. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: wait_for_chunks_to_load
tools.description: Wait until enough chunks around the bot have loaded. Use after connect/teleport before reading the world. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: goto
tools.description: Navigate to a goal using the pathfinder and block until arrival (or timeout). Supports block/near/xz/nearxz/y/getToBlock/lookAtBlock/placeBlock and composite_any/composite_all/invert (nested via `goals`). Cancellable; throws NO_PATH if unreachable, TIMEOUT if it takes too long. Guarded dry-land navigation rejects water and low oxygen, never automatically retries, and waits for actual cancellation settlement. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: set_goal
tools.description: Set a pathfinder goal without waiting (fire-and-forget). The bot keeps moving toward it in the background. Use `dynamic` for goals that should recompute as the world/target changes. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: flee_from
tools.description: Continuously move away from a world point until at least `distance` blocks away (dynamic goal). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: follow_entity
tools.description: Continuously follow a tracked entity (by id), staying within `range` blocks. Dynamic goal; persists until changed/stopped. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: stop_pathfinding
tools.description: Stop active work and release controls; no reconnect.

tools.name: get_path_to
tools.description: Compute (but do not execute) a path to a goal and report its status/cost/timing without moving the bot. Useful to test reachability before committing to `goto`. This dry-profile estimate does not apply the temporary already-open wooden-door adapter used by verified goto. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: set_control_state
tools.description: Hold or release a single low-level movement control (forward/back/left/right/jump/sprint/sneak). Manual control; conflicts with active pathfinding. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: clear_control_states
tools.description: Stop active work and release controls; no reconnect.

tools.name: elytra_fly
tools.description: Begin elytra gliding flight. Requires equipped elytra and that the bot is already gliding; otherwise fails as UNSUPPORTED. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: wait_for_ticks
tools.description: Block until the given number of game ticks have elapsed (20 ticks ~= 1 second). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: look_at
tools.description: Aim the bot's head at a world point (x,y,z). Use `force` to snap instantly instead of turning smoothly over time. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: look
tools.description: Set the bot's absolute head orientation in radians (yaw, pitch). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: look_at_entity
tools.description: Aim the bot's head at a tracked entity (by id), targeting its approximate eye height. Re-call to keep tracking a moving target. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: dig
tools.description: Dig (break) the block at a world coordinate, equipping the best tool automatically. Set `action:"stop"` to abort the current dig. This is a cancellable long-running action. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: place_block
tools.description: Place a block (or entity, e.g. boat/minecart) against a reference block's face. Equips `itemName` first if given. faceVector is the unit direction from the reference block toward the new block. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: activate_block
tools.description: Right-click / activate the block at a coordinate (buttons, levers, doors, chests-as-interaction, etc.). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: activate_entity
tools.description: Right-click / interact with a tracked entity (e.g. trade with a villager, mount a vehicle). Use `useHeldItem` to use the held item on it, or `position` to interact at a specific point. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: swing_arm
tools.description: Play the arm-swing animation (cosmetic / to trigger left-click interactions). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: pvp_attack
tools.description: Continuously attack a target entity using the pvp plugin (pathfinds into range and keeps swinging). Resolves when the target dies or is lost. Long-running and cancellable. Provide an entityId, or a `target` filter (type/name/username) to pick the nearest match. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: attack_entity
tools.description: Perform a single melee attack swing against a tracked entity (one-shot; does not pathfind or repeat). Use pvp_attack for sustained combat. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: pvp_stop
tools.description: Stop active work and release controls; no reconnect.

tools.name: pvp_configure
tools.description: Configure pvp plugin parameters: followRange, attackRange, viewDistance, and meleeMode ('maxDamage' waits for the weapon cooldown for max damage; 'fast' attacks as quickly as possible). Returns the current numeric config. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: equip_item
tools.description: Equip an item from inventory to a destination slot. `hand`/`off-hand` hold it; `head`/`torso`/`legs`/`feet` wear armor. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: unequip_item
tools.description: Remove whatever is equipped at a destination slot (e.g. take off a helmet, empty the off-hand). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: toss_item
tools.description: Drop items on the ground. Provide `slot` to toss that exact inventory slot's whole stack, or `item` (+ optional `count`) to toss by item type (omitting count tosses the whole stack). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: set_quickbar_slot
tools.description: Select the active hotbar slot (0-8), like scrolling the mouse wheel to a hotbar position. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: consume
tools.description: Eat or drink the currently held item (food/potion). Hold the consumable in the main hand first. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: activate_item
tools.description: Start or stop using the held item (right-click hold). Use action `start` to begin (e.g. draw a bow, raise a shield, eat) and `stop` to release. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: click_window
tools.description: Low-level window click. `slot` is the window slot index, `mouseButton` 0=left/1=right, `mode` 0-6 (0 normal, 1 shift, 2 number-key, 4 drop, etc). Prefer higher-level tools when possible. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: move_slot_item
tools.description: Move the stack in `sourceSlot` to `destSlot` within the open window/inventory. If `destSlot` is omitted, put the item away into the main inventory (out of the hotbar/crafting/armor area). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: transfer_items
tools.description: Bulk-transfer a quantity of an item between slot ranges of a window. Defaults move within the player inventory (slots 9-45). Set `window` true to operate on the currently open container window instead. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: open_container
tools.description: Open a chest/barrel/shulker/dispenser/hopper at a block coordinate (x,y,z) or a container entity (entityId, e.g. a chest minecart). Keeps the window open as the active container session for read_open_container / container_deposit / container_withdraw until close_window. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: read_open_container
tools.description: Read the contents of the currently-open container: its own slots (containerItems) and the bot's inventory slots (inventoryItems). Throws NO_WINDOW if no container is open. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: container_deposit
tools.description: Move items from the bot's inventory into the open container. Specify count to deposit a fixed amount, or omit to deposit all matching items. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: container_withdraw
tools.description: Move items from the open container into the bot's inventory. Specify count to withdraw a fixed amount, or omit to withdraw all matching items. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: close_window
tools.description: Close the currently-open window/container session (chest, furnace, villager, enchant, anvil). Safe to call even if nothing is open. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: open_furnace
tools.description: Open the furnace (or blast furnace / smoker) at the given coordinates and return its current contents. Keeps the window open for subsequent furnace_action / furnace_status calls. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: furnace_action
tools.description: Put items into, or take items out of, the currently-open furnace. `slot` selects input/fuel/output; `op` is put or take. Output cannot be put into. Requires an open furnace (open_furnace first). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: furnace_status
tools.description: Read the currently-open furnace's input/fuel/output items and fuel/smelt progress (0..1). Requires an open furnace. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: smelt_item
tools.description: Smelt items end-to-end: open the furnace at furnacePos (or use the already-open furnace), load fuel + input, then poll until `count` outputs have been produced, fuel runs out, or the input is exhausted, collecting outputs as they appear. Cancellable. Approach: drives off the furnace `update` event with a per-wait tick timeout, re-checking progress/slots each cycle. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: enchant_item
tools.description: Open the enchantment table at (x,y,z), insert an item (and lapis lazuli if available), and read or apply an enchantment offer. Omit `choice` to just return the three offers (top/middle/bottom slots 0/1/2). Provide `choice` (0-2) to apply that offer and take the enchanted item back. Requires line of sight / reach to the table and lapis lazuli in inventory to actually enchant. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: anvil_combine
tools.description: Open the anvil at (x,y,z) and combine/repair two items (or rename a single item). Identify each input either by inventory slot number (itemOneSlot/itemTwoSlot) or by item name/id (itemOne/itemTwo); slot wins if both are given. Provide only the first item plus `name` to rename. Costs experience levels; result is taken back into inventory. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: open_villager
tools.description: Walk up to and open trading with a villager entity (by id). Returns the list of trades with their input/output items, indices, disabled flag and max uses. Use trade_with_villager to execute a trade. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: trade_with_villager
tools.description: Execute a trade with the currently-open villager by trade index (from open_villager). `times` runs the trade repeatedly. Requires an open villager window. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: List crafting recipes for an item. By default returns only recipes craftable with the bot's current inventory (recipesFor); set includeUnavailable to list every known recipe (recipesAll). Set useCraftingTable to consider table-only recipes using a crafting table within 4 blocks. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: craft_item
tools.description: Craft an item using the bot's inventory. Uses a crafting table within 4 blocks (or at craftingTablePos) when the recipe requires one. Crafts `count` times (default 1). Cancellable. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: collect_block
tools.description: Break and collect block(s) (or pick up an item-drop entity) using the collectblock plugin. `target` is a block name (collects the N nearest, see `count`), a {x,y,z} block position, or a numeric entity id (item drop). When the inventory fills, items are deposited into `chestLocations`; use `depositItems`/`keepItems` to control what gets stored. Long-running and cancellable. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: cancel_collect
tools.description: Stop active work and release controls; no reconnect.

tools.name: set_collect_config
tools.description: Set persistent collectblock defaults: the chest locations to deposit into when full, and the item filter (depositItems or keepItems) used for those deposits. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: equip_tool_for_block
tools.description: Equip the best tool in inventory for breaking a target block. Specify the block by coordinates (x,y,z) or by blockId (nearest matching block within 64 is used). With getFromChest, retrieves a suitable tool from a configured tool chest if none is held. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: set_tool_chest_locations
tools.description: Configure the chest locations the tool plugin may pull tools from when equip_tool_for_block uses getFromChest. Modes: 'set' (replace, default), 'add' (append), 'clear' (remove all). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_best_tool
tools.description: Determine the best harvest tool currently in inventory for the block at the given coordinates, without equipping it. Returns null if no tool is better than hand. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: autoeat_set_enabled
tools.description: Enable or disable the automatic eating behavior (eats when hunger/health drop below the configured thresholds). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: autoeat_configure
tools.description: Configure auto-eat options. Only the provided fields are changed. priority selects how food is ranked; minHunger/minHealth are the thresholds that trigger auto-eating; bannedFood lists item names to never eat. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: autoeat_eat
tools.description: Eat a food item once, now. Optionally specify which food; otherwise the best available food is chosen by the current priority. Throws MISSING_ITEM when no suitable food is available. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: autoeat_cancel
tools.description: Stop active work and release controls; no reconnect.

tools.name: autoeat_preview
tools.description: Preview which inventory foods would be chosen, ranked best-first, under the given (or current) priority. Read-only. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: armor_equip_all
tools.description: Automatically equip the best available armor pieces from the bot's inventory. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: sleep
tools.description: Sleep in the bed at the given coordinates. Only works at night (or during a thunderstorm) with no nearby monsters, and the bed must be within reach. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: wake
tools.description: Wake up / get out of the bed the bot is currently sleeping in. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: mount_entity
tools.description: Mount a rideable entity (boat, minecart, horse, etc.) identified by its network id. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: dismount
tools.description: Dismount from the vehicle the bot is currently riding. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: steer_vehicle
tools.description: Steer the currently-mounted vehicle. `left` and `forward` range from -1 to 1 (e.g. forward=1 to go ahead, left=-1 to turn right). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: fish
tools.description: Cast a fishing line and wait for a bite (requires a fishing rod held in hand). Resolves when a catch is reeled in. Long-running and cancellable (via cancel_task or cancel_fish). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: cancel_fish
tools.description: Stop active work and release controls; no reconnect.

tools.name: write_book
tools.description: Write text into a book-and-quill held/located at the given inventory slot. Each array element is one page. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: update_sign
tools.description: Edit the text on a sign block at (x,y,z). Use `back` to write the back face. Read sign text back via get_block_at. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a public chat message to the server. To run a slash command use `run_command` instead. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: whisper
tools.description: Send a private message (whisper) to a specific player. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: tab_complete
tools.description: Ask the server for tab-completion suggestions for the given partial text (e.g. command arguments or player names). Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: remove_chat_pattern
tools.description: Remove a previously registered chat pattern by its name or numeric id. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Drain buffered game events (chat, deaths, block/entity changes, goal_reached, etc.). Pass the returned `nextSince` on the next call to read only new events without gaps. `dropped:true` means the buffer overflowed and some events between your `since` and now were lost. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Stop active work and release controls; no reconnect.

tools.name: render_map
tools.description: Render a bounded two-dimensional schematic of loaded blocks; not a native screenshot. The optional local read-only observer provides reconstructed 3D separately. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: set_waypoint
tools.description: Save a named waypoint (persisted to disk, survives restarts). Omit x/y/z to capture the bot's current position. Re-using a name overwrites it. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: list_waypoints
tools.description: List all saved waypoints. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: delete_waypoint
tools.description: Delete a saved waypoint by name. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: goto_waypoint
tools.description: Navigate to a saved waypoint by name (pathfinds and blocks until arrival). Cancellable; throws NO_PATH if unreachable, TIMEOUT if it takes too long. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: clear_region
tools.description: Dig out every solid block in the axis-aligned box from `from` to `to` (inclusive). Closest blocks first; the bot repositions and auto-equips tools. Stops after `maxBlocks` digs (default 256). Cancellable; reports dug/skipped/failed. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: dig_tunnel
tools.description: Dig a straight tunnel from the bot in a horizontal direction. `length` blocks long, `width` wide (centered, default 1), `height` tall (default 2 so the bot fits). Cancellable; reports progress. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: dig_staircase
tools.description: Dig a descending staircase from the bot in a horizontal direction: each step moves one block forward and one block down, carving a `height`-tall (default 2) opening so the bot can walk down. `depth` is how many blocks to descend. Cancellable. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.

tools.name: fill_region
tools.description: Place `block` into every empty (air) cell of the axis-aligned box from `from` to `to`. Best-effort: the bot must have the material and be able to reach a supporting face — cells with no adjacent solid to build against are skipped. Stops after `maxBlocks` placements (default 256). Cancellable; reports placed/skipped/failed. Reused upstream operation on MCPBot’s existing session; server confirmations are preserved. Continuous controls are bounded and stop before return.
